name: feature-flow
description: Capture ideas, plan features, and coordinate reviewed implementation delivery.

interface.shortDescription: Capture ideas and plan complete feature bundles.
interface.longDescription: Feature Flow provides separate Idea, Plan, and Implement skills. Idea records durable GitHub Ideas; Plan converges Feature Specs and implementation issues; Implement coordinates isolated workers through reviewed PR-ready delivery while delegating GitHub transport to GitStack.
defaultPrompt: Use $idea to capture this proposal as a durable Idea.
Use $plan to turn this Idea into an agent-ready feature bundle.
Use $implement to coordinate delivery of a Feature Spec.
